shopify_token_help: Enter a new Admin API access token for {shop}. Then validate access so Luma can read the store again.
shopify_authorize_help: Shopify asks you to approve access to read orders, products, inventory, returns, and fulfillment, and to change inventory and fulfillments. Luma changes them only through actions your workspace allows. You can cancel before approving.
shopify_access_check_failed: Luma couldn’t check this store’s Shopify access. {error}
shopify_access_history_full: Access to older orders is on. How far back Luma can read depends on the history the store keeps.
shopify_access_history_limited: Luma can read orders from the last 60 days. Older orders need approval from Shopify and a new authorization.
shopify_access_customers_unavailable: Customer details aren’t available until Shopify approves access to customer data and the store grants it.
shopify_access_missing: Shopify hasn’t granted access to {permissions}. Reconnect the store to request it.
shopify_page_description: Read orders, payments, fulfillment, and stock directly from your Shopify stores.
shopify_page_empty: No Shopify store is connected. Connect a store in Apps to browse its records.
shopify_records_help: Read a record from this store, then follow its linked orders, variants, inventory, returns, and refunds.
shopify_records_id_placeholder: ID from the Shopify admin URL
shopify_record_error_not_found: Luma couldn’t find this record in Shopify, or the connection is no longer available. Orders older than 60 days need access to older orders.
shopify_record_error_forbidden: This connection doesn’t have access to this record. Check its permissions in Apps.
shopify_record_error_invalid: Choose the matching record type and enter its Shopify ID.
shopify_context_no_order_id: This order has no Shopify order ID, so Luma can’t read live details from Shopify.
shopify_recovery_help: Review one exact change, approve it, then check the result in Shopify.
shopify_recovery_expired: This preview expired. Refresh the fulfillment details and review the action again.
shopify_recovery_interrupted: The connection was interrupted, so Luma couldn’t confirm the result. Refresh to see the saved recovery before you try again.
shopify_recovery_hold_help: Luma releases only this hold. Other holds stay in place.
shopify_recovery_destination_help: Moves all remaining items. Items already fulfilled stay at their original location.
shopify_recovery_expires: This preview expires at {time}. If the order changes in Shopify, review it again.
shopify_stock_description: Set available stock in Shopify to the quantity your ERP reports. Review and approve the change, then check it in Shopify.
shopify_stock_rules: Luma changes only available stock in Shopify. Your ERP stays the source of truth. Someone else who can approve changes must approve each correction.
shopify_stock_expired: This review expired. Sync the ERP and refresh before you review again.
shopify_stock_interrupted: The connection was interrupted, so Luma couldn’t confirm the result. Refresh to see the saved correction before you continue.
shopify_stock_missing_sources: To correct stock here, Luma needs an active Shopify connection and a matching ERP source. Check that the SKU and location are linked in both systems, then sync both.
shopify_stock_delta: {count, plural, one {{delta} unit in Shopify} other {{delta} units in Shopify}}
shopify_stock_expires: This review expires {time}. If stock changes in either system, review it again.
shopify_blocker_correction_write_access: Reconnect Shopify and allow Luma to change inventory.
shopify_blocker_correction_untracked: Shopify didn’t confirm that it tracks stock at this location.
shopify_blocker_correction_stale: Stock data is more than five minutes old. Refresh before you review a correction.
shopify_blocker_correction_already_match: Shopify already shows the same quantity as your inventory system. No correction is needed.
shopify_blocker_recovery_write_access: Reconnect Shopify and allow Luma to change fulfillments.
shopify_blocker_recovery_incomplete: Shopify sent incomplete fulfillment details. Refresh before you continue.
shopify_blocker_recovery_closed: This fulfillment order is closed or canceled.
shopify_blocker_recovery_not_allowed: Shopify doesn’t allow this action in the fulfillment’s current state.
shopify_blocker_recovery_hold_gone: The selected hold no longer exists.
shopify_blocker_recovery_cancellation_pe: The fulfillment service must accept the cancellation before this order can move.
shopify_blocker_recovery_location_unavai: Shopify can’t move all remaining items to this location.
shopify_subscriptions_help: Reconnect Shopify to repair subscriptions. Scheduled scans recover missed changes. Registration does not prove delivery.
shopify_blocker_correction_bundle_parent: Bundle stock is derived from its components. Review component stock instead.
shopify_native_publication_whole_units: Enter a nonnegative whole-unit allocation up to 2,147,483,647. Luma does not round native stock.
shopify_native_publication_rules: Publish only an approved allocation from this owned location. Native balances, mappings, authority and Shopify storage are checked again. Activation and other stock states stay under separate authority.
shopify_native_publication_table: Allocation and Shopify storage before dispatch
shopify_order_edit_help: Change how many units of unfulfilled lines this order contains. The exact change needs approval, and Luma checks fulfillment and recalculates the order again right before sending it.
shopify_order_edit_restock_help: Only applies to lines you reduce.
shopify_order_edit_no_change: Change at least one quantity to preview an edit.
shopify_order_edit_on_hold: Fulfillment of a changed line is on hold. The edit can still be sent; the hold stays.
shopify_order_edit_observe_only: Writes are off for this workspace or store. Luma records the change but sends nothing to Shopify, not even the calculation.
shopify_order_edit_describe: Change {count, plural, one {{count, number} line} other {{count, number} lines}} on this Shopify order
shopify_order_edit_not_calculated: Shopify did not calculate the new totals because writes are off.
shopify_order_edit_calculated_by_shopify: Calculated by Shopify without changing the order. A different calculation before sending needs a new approval.
shopify_order_edit_authority: Order lines in this workspace come from this store (authority revision {revision}).
shopify_order_edit_message_preview: Review the exact change. Shopify is checked and recalculated again before it is sent.
shopify_order_edit_message_awaiting_othe: Someone else who can approve changes must approve this exact edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_awaiting_self: Review and approve this exact edit before sending it.
shopify_order_edit_message_approved: Approved. The requester can send the edit after a fresh check.
shopify_order_edit_message_uncertain: Luma sent the edit, but Shopify’s answer was lost. Luma reads Shopify to learn the outcome and will not send it again.
shopify_order_edit_message_accepted: Shopify accepted the edit. A fresh read has not confirmed the new quantities yet.
shopify_order_edit_message_verified: A fresh Shopify read shows the approved quantities and Luma’s edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_withheld: Nothing changed in Shopify. Review the order again before another edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_not_applied: Shopify shows the edit was not applied. Luma will not send it again; review a new edit if it is still needed.
shopify_order_edit_message_changed: The order changed since this preview. Review a new edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_expired: This preview expired. Review a new edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_rejected: A person with approval permission rejected this edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_policy: Approval rules changed. Review a new edit.
shopify_order_edit_message_observe_only: Would be sent when writes are enabled. Nothing was sent to Shopify.
shopify_order_edit_interrupted: The request was interrupted. Check the edit before trying again.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_write_access: Reconnect Shopify to allow order edits.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_incomplete: Shopify returned incomplete order details. Refresh before continuing.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_authority: Order lines in this workspace come from another source that doesn’t show these quantities. Review source authority or the order there before editing.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_unknown_line: A selected line is no longer on this order.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_no_change: A new quantity equals the current quantity.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_fulfillment_r: Sent to a fulfillment service. Cancel that request first.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_fulfillment_u: Shopify reports fulfillment work Luma can’t confirm as unstarted.
shopify_order_edit_blocker_authority_sta: The source that order lines come from wasn’t read completely in the last five minutes. Wait for its next read and refresh.
shopify_publishing_help: Publish a physically dispatched parcel. The reviewed allocation and tracking need approval. No new carrier shipment or label is created.
shopify_publishing_empty: No downstream parcels are linked to this order yet. Refresh the order’s sources after dispatch.
shopify_publishing_disabled: Shipment publishing is not enabled for this workspace.
shopify_publishing_confirm: I confirm these exact items, quantities and warehouse belong to this dispatched parcel.
shopify_publishing_allocation_help: The carrier does not identify the items or warehouse for this parcel. Your exact allocation will be saved for approval; verify it against the warehouse dispatch record.
shopify_publishing_notify: Notify the customer about this shipment or tracking update
shopify_publishing_ineligible: This selection needs current dispatch evidence and an exact eligible Shopify allocation.
shopify_publishing_state_preview: Review the exact shipment before approval.
shopify_publishing_state_approval_requir: This exact shipment needs approval before the requester can publish it.
shopify_publishing_state_denied: This preview cannot run. Refresh the evidence and review a new preview.
shopify_publishing_state_verified: A fresh Shopify read verified the exact allocation and tracking.
shopify_publishing_state_uncertain: The send outcome is unknown. Check Shopify independently; this action will not be sent again.
shopify_publishing_state_accepted: Shopify accepted the write. The shipment is not yet independently verified.
shopify_publishing_observe: Observe-only: no Shopify change or customer notification was sent.
shopify_publishing_notification_unknown: Whether Shopify accepted the customer notification is unknown. Notification delivery is not verified.
shopify_publishing_state_ready: This exact shipment is approved and ready for the requester to publish.
